name: Metalcraft Packs
description: Discover integrations in the Metalcraft Packs registry (packs.metalcraftai.com): search and browse the catalog, read a pack's details and required keys, see featured packs, and check a pack's latest version. Read-only discovery over the registry's public API — needs no key. To actually install a pack onto this agent, use the 'My Agent' page at packs.metalcraftai.com.
